info.name: Griffion - Complete API Collection
info.description: Complete API test collection for Griffion-generated backends. Includes Authentication (with 2FA), Admin Panel, User Management, Roles, Groups, Navigation, and bulk operations.

request.description: Register new user with default public role from config.json. No role parameter specified = uses defaultPublicRole from config.
Register user with specific public role. User chooses 'Buyer' role during registration.
Register user with specific public role. User chooses 'Seller' role during registration.

exec: console.log('✓ Correctly rejected admin role:', jsonData.message);

request.description: Attempt to register as admin role. Should fail with 400 error because Admin is registrationType: 'admin', not public.
Register user with ONLY email and password. All other fields optional. Gets default role from config.
Register user with username (if PRIMARY_IDENTIFIER=username). Can use email or username to login based on config.

exec: console.log('✓ Full custom user:', jsonData.data.email, 'Role:', jsonData.data.role);

request.description: Register with ALL custom fields: username, email, password, firstName, lastName, role. Maximum customization for user selection.
Register with only firstName (lastName optional). Test partial custom profile.

exec: console.log('✓ Custom registration with Buyer role');

request.description: Custom user selection: username + specific public role (Buyer). Shows flexibility of registration.
Login with email and password. Returns access token, refresh token, and user info.
Login with 2FA enabled. Include totpToken (from authenticator app) in request. Replace 000000 with actual TOTP token.
Get new access token using refresh token. Refresh tokens last 7 days.
Generate QR code and secret for 2FA setup. Scan QR code with authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, etc.)
Verify 2FA token from authenticator app and enable 2FA. Replace 000000 with actual TOTP from your authenticator.
Disable 2FA for your account. Requires password verification.
Logout user. Invalidates refresh token.
Get current user's profile information.
Update current user's profile information.
Change current user's password. Requires current password.
Get user's preferences and settings.
Update user's preferences. Send preferences as nested object.
Get all available roles with permissions and registration types. Shows which roles are public (available for self-signup) vs admin-only.
Get paginated list of all users. Requires admin role. Supports filtering by role.
Get specific user details by ID.
Create single user as admin. Can assign any role (admin, public, etc.). Email with login credentials will be sent.
Create up to 100 users at once. Each user receives welcome email with login credentials and instructions to change password on first login.
Update user details as admin. Can change role, lock/unlock account.
Delete user account.
Get all roles with their permissions. Shows registrationType (public, admin, custom) which determines self-registration eligibility.
Create new role. registrationType='public' allows self-registration, 'admin' requires admin to create users.
Update role permissions and description.
Delete role. Cannot delete system roles.
Get all user groups.
Create new user group.
Add user to group.
Remove user from group.
Get audit log entries. Track user actions for compliance and security.
Get system statistics (total users, roles, groups, etc.)
Get dynamic navigation menu based on user role and permissions.
Check backend health and enabled features.
Request password reset. Email with reset link (valid 1 hour) will be sent.
Reset password using token from email. Token is valid for 1 hour.
